question: Which of the following is not the use of baking soda?
solution:
The correct answer is __**bleaching action**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bleaching Action **is not used in **Baking soda.**
 
• **Baking soda (sodium bicarbonate**) is a mild alkaline compound with various uses: 
 
• **Antacids**:
 
 
• It neutralizes excess stomach acid, providing relief from heartburn and indigestion. 
 
 
 
• **Fire extinguishers:**
 
 
• It reacts with acids to produce carbon dioxide, which helps extinguish fires. 
 
 
 
• **Baking powder**:
 
 
• A key ingredient in baking powder, where it reacts with acids to release carbon dioxide, causing baked goods to rise.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Baking soda was first manufactured by French chemist Nicolas Leblanc.
 
• It was first manufactured in 1971.
 
• The common name of Sodium bicarbonate is Baking soda.
 
• Sodium bicarbonate is non flammable.
 
• Baking soda is basic in nature.
 
• Uses of Sodium bicarbonate are following:-
 
 
• It acts as an antacid that is used to treat stomach
 
• It is used in fire extinguishers due to the formation of soapy foam
 
• It acts as a pesticide
 
• It neutralizes the effect of acid as a neutralizer
 
• In the stomach, Reduces the acidity
